# T3 joint predictor-tokenization factorial (+ T3b canary): structural pins

- **Role:** the Builder
- **Date:** 2026-08-26 (Builder slice Q3 of the T-series program, PR #146,
  issue #130)
- **Authority:** spec addendum 20 (algorithmic-spec.md sections 20.4/20.5)
  and the T-series blueprint (`architecture-jxl-parity-tseries.md`
  sections 2/7) are binding. Everything below lands BEFORE any
  `bench-sandbox --t3` / `--t3b` row exists; nothing retunes any
  addendum-20 constant.

## P-Q3-1 Candidate scope

Six cells {MED, GAP, W} x {ZFFCTRL, ZZ-HU} x ALL SEVEN D4c color trials,
all measured on the quad (addendum 20.4 verbatim). Predictor streams come
from the EXISTING `compute_residuals_family` machinery per 18.4 as
repaired by amendments A4/A4b - zero new predictor mathematics.
ZZ-HU is a ROW-SCHEMA NAME ONLY: it is `TokProfile::HYB_C` reused
verbatim (addendum 18.3 ladder ESC-C), exactly as 20.4 pins. Stack per
cell: KFLAT16 keying x B-RANS for verdict rows; B-IDEAL rows are
fidelity-rail diagnostics and never enter any winner choice; tables +
'SBP1' fully NETTED; zero maps/trees/assign by schema (flat keying).

## P-Q3-2 Cell NET and per-image selection

Per image per cell the reported NET is the first strict minimum over the
seven trials' B-RANS rows, scanning trials ascending (ties = lowest
color-trial id) - L-C1 real bytes per image, S4/T-BASE precedent. The
fresh-in-run T-BASE winner ({ADAPT, SPINE} by real NET, ties to ADAPT) is
computed and cited beside the readout as program continuity context but
NEVER gates T3: bar (i) is a cell-vs-cell comparison inside the factorial
and needs no external denominator.

## P-Q3-3 Bar (i) reading (pinned BEFORE measurement)

Addendum 20.5: "best non-MED family >= +1.50 pct median NET over MED
under ITS winning tokenization". Pinned mechanical reading:

    tok*(F, i) = argmin over tok of net(i, (F, tok)), ties to ZFFCTRL
                 (control-conservative)
    margin_i(F) = 100 * (net(MED@tok*(F,i), i) - net(F@tok*(F,i), i))
                  / net(MED@tok*(F,i), i)
    margin(F)   = quad median of margin_i(F)

PASS iff max(margin(GAP), margin(W)) >= +1.50. MED is scored under THE
SAME tokenization as the family on each image (apples-to-apples within a
cell pair). Recorded beside, never gating: (a) the variant where MED
keeps its own best tokenization per image; (b) the variant with one
quad-level tokenization choice per family (median-NET choice). On FAIL,
GAP and W take their THIRD AND FINAL strike and B3/B5 close permanently
per the binding decision tree; no later phase may re-open either family.

## P-Q3-4 Bar (ii) recording

Tokenization main effect recorded in BOTH directions as the F3
cross-check: for each family F in {MED, GAP, W},
delta_i(tok) = 100 * (net(i,(F,ZFFCTRL)) - net(i,(F,ZZ-HU)))
                   / net(i,(F,ZFFCTRL)); quad medians printed per family
(positive = ZZ-HU smaller = ZZ-HU wins for that family). This is a
RECORDING obligation, never a pass/fail gate, and it feeds no strike.

## P-Q3-5 Canary target selection

T3b rides EXACTLY ONCE on the winner regardless of the bar-(i) outcome
(20.4 says "the winner", unconditionally): if bar (i) passes for at least
one non-MED family, the target cell is that family under the
tokenization chosen by quad-median cell NET (margin ties -> ZFFCTRL
tokenization, then GAP before W by enum order); otherwise the target is
MED under ITS quad-median-winning tokenization (ties -> ZFFCTRL). The
evaluator prints the machine-readable line
`T3 CANARY TARGET: <FAM>@<TOK>`; `--t3b FAM@TOK` takes it as an argument
(no interactive input anywhere). The canary's outcome affects composition
candidacy only; it can never reopen a family the factorial closed.

## P-Q3-6 Canary mechanics (20.4 + inherited 14.2/14.3 constants verbatim)

ctx = 8 * bucket(gN) + bucket(gW); gradients from DECODED pixels under
the shared border rule (`bias_gradients`: y == 0 -> gN = gW = 0; y > 0
with x == 0 -> gN keeps P[N] as its term, gW = 0); buckets count
thresholds {0,1,2,4,8,16,32} << (bd-8) strictly below |g|, capped at 7.
pred' = pred_family + b[ctx] as an exact integer add: b entries are
integers, so 14.3's round() / 20.4's round_half_around are identity
operations here (recorded; no hidden rounding exists). err' = actual -
pred'; the CODED residual is err'. Post-decode update
b[ctx] <- clamp(b[ctx] + floor_div(err', 64), -Bmax, +Bmax) with
BIAS_SHIFT = 6 and Bmax = 2^(bd-3) (BD8: shift 64, Bmax 32).

Structural readings pinned (no addendum text covers them):
- W-ensemble interaction: the ensemble updates against ITS OWN
  uncorrected prediction with error actual - pred (18.4 verbatim,
  self-contained state); the bias correction applies AFTER the ensemble
  output and learns from the full corrected error err'. Each adaptive
  state consumes its own prediction error; mixing would charge one error
  into two states. The decoder mirrors this identically.
- Per-plane state reset for b[] (production scoping precedent
  BiasModel::reset; families already reset per plane).

## P-Q3-7 'SBB2' bias-table serializer

The canary table is transmitted, not recomputed: magic 'SBB2', u32 n=64,
then 64 s16 little-endian values (delta toward the zero prior = the raw
values), CRC32 over the uncompressed span, whole span compressed ONCE by
the plane-rANS engine (pin D6 scheme) - 'SBD1' shape precedent minus
parents. Named HERE because 20.4 left the container unnamed and 'SBB1'
is already the B-BAC payload magic. Decoder mirror exact; truncation /
CRC / content tamper hard-detect with the expect-match surface identical
to deserialize_tables. Bias blob bytes are ALWAYS NETTED, reported in a
dedicated `bias` column (I12 extension; net-audit-t checks the identity
including it).

## P-Q3-8 CSV schema

One file per phase (addendum 20.6):
`benchmarks/results/2026-08-26-sandbox-t3.csv`, carrying BOTH stages:

    T3,img,cand,tok,trial,be,payload,tables,maps,trees,assign,net,
        audit,rt,tbl_bits
    T3CELL,img,fam,tok,trial,p,t,m,tr,a,net
    T3B,img,cand,tok,trial,be,payload,tables,maps,trees,bias,assign,
        net,audit,rt,tbl_bits
    T3BS,img,arm,trial,p,t,m,tr,a,b,net,relpct

cand/fam in {MED, GAP, W}; tok in {ZFFCTRL, ZZHU}. T3CELL embeds the
mandatory per-image min-trial decomposition so bar (i) is auditable from
the file alone; T3BS embeds canary-vs-base components per image. Anchors
+ T-BASE ride the existing SANDBOX/BRACKET/T1 schemas (t2a precedent).
The evaluator cross-checks every summary against raw rows (rail, not
trust).

## P-Q3-9 Baselines fresh in-run

Bar (i) compares cells measured in the SAME invocation. T3b compares the
canary against the SAME base cell re-measured FRESH inside the --t3b
invocation (never numbers carried across runs or files). Quad sha-pins
verified BEFORE any row.

## P-Q3-10 Rails before verdicts

All six VB rails green on the new families BEFORE any verdict line:
anchors bit-for-bit (re-emitted inside the CSV); coder fidelity within
+0.50 pct per (img, cand, tok, trial) family including canary families;
net-audit extended to the T3B bias column; EVERY coded row decodes
round-trip clean, and canary rows additionally prove FULL PLANE
reconstruction equality (decode events -> causal bias walk -> pixel-exact
source plane); determinism byte-identical full re-run. Gate verdicts
never flip exit codes; rail failures always do.

## P-Q3-11 Verdicts live in the evaluator; failability proven

probe_sandbox.sh parses T3/T3CELL/T3B/T3BS rows, recomputes margins,
medians and both bar-(ii) directions, prints T3/T3B VERDICT lines plus
the canary-target line WITHOUT flipping exit codes, and gains
`--self-check-t3`: a fabricated consistent frame must pass the rails and
render honest losing verdicts; the +1.50 bar must be reachable in BOTH
directions; the canary verdict must flip when a single image violates
the -0.25 floor even with its median above +0.50; and named mutations
(cell NET identity break, T3BS decomposition lie, schema leak, rt lie)
must each flip their named rail. Zero container bytes throughout;
wall-clock logged beside the run per the A3 precedent.

## P-Q3-12 Strike ledger wording

On a bar-(i) FAIL the tracker records "GAP and W take their third and
final strike" verbatim (pre-registered framing; B3/B5 close permanently).
On a canary FAIL the tracker records the first strike against the
bias-feedback budget (two-strike lifetime per the 19.5/14.3 lineage; S2
never opened and explicitly consumed none); a second failure anywhere
closes bias feedback forever.
